entity_raw.definition_raw: Friendship SubdomainSource Inner Sea Gods pg. 225, Blood of Angels pg. 27Associated Domain(s): GoodAssociated Deities: Chaldira, Elion, Findeladlara, Gruhastha, Grundinnar, Lymnieris, Lythertida, Omrataji, Seramaydiel, Sinashakti, Upion and WarrikReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the touch of good power of the Good domain. Powerful Bond (Su): As a free action, you can open a link to communicate telepathically with a single ally within 60 feet. The telepathic link is two-way and lasts for 1 minute. Unlike normal telepathy, this ability requires a shared language. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—shield other, 5th—telepathic bond.
